description: This file declares the MessageDispatcher class, which implements the IMessageDispatcher interface and manages media key client interactions, including license requests, renewals, and key status changes. It also defines an inner class MessageDispatcherClient for client management.

classes.name: MessageDispatcher
classes.description: Main class implementing message dispatching and client management for media keys.

classes.name: MessageDispatcher::MessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: Inner class managing individual media key client instances.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IMessageDispatcherClient for the given IMediaKeysClient.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request events with session ID, message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal events with session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Handles key status change events with session ID and key statuses.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Adds a media keys client to the internal set.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a media keys client from the internal set.
